technical_requirements: Latency: suggestion latency target 100-150ms median for < 50 token prompts; 95th < 350ms. Throughput: baseline 120 concurrent agents, burst to 450 concurrent during incidents. Models: prefer vetted open models; need model pins + offline model bundle support (no external downloads). Runtime: must run in isolated VLAN, support continuous batching disabled for low-latency paths, optional quantized models for cost. KV cache required for agent context (per-call). Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdown, signed audit logs forwarded to local SIEM, retention controls (7yr for audit logs). Fallbacks: local smaller model + graceful degradation path when capacity constrained. Integrations: ServiceNow tool-calls, Avaya PBX adapter, SSO via SAML with IdP, customer-managed HSM (PKCS#11). Compliance: FIPS-140 validated crypto stack and IL4 policy support. POC metrics: latency histogram, suggestion precision/recall, summarization human-eval score, cost-per-minute estimate for burst scenarios.
